name: Bacchus de Qingdian
source:
As a new actress, you accidentally join the Mysterious Theater and begin growing into a huge star. This is not only a huge gift from Gods, but also a great challenge to human nature. Will the rising star be devoured by temptation? 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2183180/]Steam[/url]]
